resources.string: The Google Fit service is being phased out, and we encourage you to switch to Health Connect to continue syncing your fitness and health data. Please select Health Connect below to ensure a smooth experience and stay up-to-date with the latest features for tracking your health and fitness.
Syncs data from various apps and devices, giving you a complete view of your health information in one place.
Thank you for making the switch to ensure you get the best experience moving forward!
